title: Out-of-Pocket Ceiling on the Member Portion of Internal Appeals — Insurance Coverage & Claims Desk Guidance
content:
**Desk guidance, Insurance Coverage & Claims.** On an internal appeal filed by Halverson Clinical Laboratories with a contracted commercial plan, the internal appeal's member portion is held to the member's out-of-pocket room under an out-of-pocket ceiling of 2500.00 USD.

## Rule

The member responsibility assigned on the coverage within the last twelve months is compared with the ceiling of 2500.00 USD:

- where that responsibility has already reached the ceiling, the member portion is **zero**;
- where it has not reached the ceiling but that responsibility plus the member portion would pass the ceiling, the member portion is **the ceiling less that responsibility**;
- otherwise the member portion **stands as figured**.

The internal appeal's plan portion is its valued charges less its member portion so held.

*Member responsibility* here is every patient-responsibility amount assigned on the coverage within the last twelve months, of whatever type.

## Cases (hypothetical figures, member portion as figured 120.00 USD)

| Responsibility assigned in the twelve months | Test | Member portion held |
|---|---|---|
| 2500.00 | Already reached the ceiling | 0.00 |
| 2600.00 | Already reached the ceiling | 0.00 |
| 2450.00 | 2450.00 plus 120.00 is 2570.00, which passes the ceiling | 2500.00 less 2450.00, that is 50.00 |
| 2380.00 | 2380.00 plus 120.00 is exactly 2500.00, which does not pass the ceiling | 120.00 |
| 900.00 | Well below the ceiling | 120.00 |

## Points of judgement

- "Reached" includes equality: 2500.00 USD of responsibility already reaches the ceiling.
- "Pass" means exceed: a total exactly equal to 2500.00 USD does not pass it.
